prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a finished promotional key art image for the Chinese cozy farming game “晴野物语”. Landscape 16:9, requested final output 1920 × 1080 pixels, opaque full bleed.

A polished, inviting hand-painted 2.5D cartoon farm game illustration with soft rounded forms, gentle outlines, richly detailed but clean and readable. Warm early morning sunlight, fresh green meadows, turquoise sky with soft white clouds. Composition suitable for a storefront hero banner: top-center a very large, beautifully crafted cream and golden-orange Chinese game logo reading EXACTLY “晴野物语” once, chunky rounded lettering with a warm brown outline, softly dimensional, tiny leaves and a small white flower integrated into the logo. All four characters clearly readable and accurate. The logo occupies about the top quarter without touching edges.

Beneath the title an idyllic lively farm: terracotta-roof cottage and wooden windmill in the middle distance, neat plots of wheat, carrots and pumpkins, an apple orchard, white picket fences with an open front gate and a sunny winding path. Foreground focal group: a charming plump brown-and-white dairy cow with a small gold bell, a fluffy white sheep, a white chicken with a red comb and two small chicks, a cheerful orange cat and a golden puppy, naturally walking and playing together. Clear distinct faces, appealing expressions, coherent anatomy and believable feet, not overlapping into each other. The cow is the main recognizable mascot, echoing the cow-and-chicken game icon. Bright flowers and a few ripe pumpkins frame the foreground corners. A sparkling small pond on one side and rolling blue-green hills with a distant forest and tiny mine entrance suggest exploration. Carefully layered depth, premium mobile-game illustration quality, sunny, comforting and playful. Balanced wide scene with breathing room; animals, logo and important buildings inside the central 85% safe area. Fill the full horizontal frame without letterboxing.

Text must be only “晴野物语”. No extra words, no UI, no play buttons, no screenshots in the picture, no device mockup, no borders, no watermark. This is promotional illustration, not a gameplay screenshot.
export: Requested 16:9 output, resampled with macOS sips to exactly 1920x1080. Existing in-game cover unchanged.
